label: 4-inch desktop thermal label printer
description: 4-inch desktop thermal transfer/direct thermal label printer with 10/100 Ethernet, RS-232 and USB 2.0 standard; 802.11ac is an optional factory radio. Wired by default in a warehouse lab.
notes: Wired only in the standard SKU (10/100 Ethernet); Wi-Fi 802.11ac requires the optional dual-radio module. No PoE. Industrial endpoints like this often sit on a flat VLAN with the WMS.
